subject: System Design
title: Push Notification Systems
description: A 60-second lesson on Push Notification Systems.

hook.text: Your phone buzzes with a notification. That message traveled from an app server through Apple or Google to your device.

buildup.text: Push notifications go through platform gateways: APNs for Apple, FCM for Android. Apps can't push directly to devices.

discovery.text: Each device registers a unique token. The app server sends the message with the token to the platform gateway.

twist.text: Tokens change. Users reinstall apps, get new phones. Invalid tokens must be cleaned up or you waste gateway quota.

climax.text: Push systems batch millions of messages, handle token rotation, and manage delivery across two platform gateways.

punchline.text: Send to the gateway with a device token — the platform delivers it.

quiz.question: Why can't apps push notifications directly to devices?
options: Notifications must go through Apple (APNs) or Google (FCM) gateways
